nodes.label: add_domain_portfolio/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration creating the domain-portfolio schema: Domain, DomainBuyer, DomainOffer and DomainSale tables plus supporting indexes.

nodes.label: Domain
nodes.summary: Portfolio domain (name, status, purchase/expiration data, category/niche/industry, location, scoring fields brandingScore/estimatedValue/buyerDemandScore/saleProbability, AI strategy fields, archive/sold timestamps).

nodes.label: DomainBuyer
nodes.summary: Prospective buyer for a Domain (businessName, contactName, email, phone, website, location, industry, buyerScore, status, lastContactedAt).

nodes.label: DomainOffer
nodes.summary: Offer on a Domain (direction, amount, currency, status, notes, receivedAt) linked to a DomainBuyer.

nodes.label: DomainSale
nodes.summary: Completed domain sale (buyerName, buyerEmail, salePrice, currency, saleDate, marketplace, fees, notes).

nodes.summary: Key/value settings store (key, value, category, isSecret flag, timestamps) for app and integration configuration.
